OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

BorrowDisabled(address).details: Emitted when the borrow is disabled for an asset.

params.asset: The address of the asset whose borrow has been disabled.

DisableOracle(address).details: Emitted when an oracle is disabled.

params.oracle: The address of the oracle being disabled.

Reset().details: Emitted when the contract is reset.

SetOracle(address,uint256).details: Emitted when the oracle is set or updated.

params.oracle: The address of the oracle being set or updated.
params.threshold: The oracle price threshold to trigger the kill switch.

Trigger(address,uint256,uint256).details: Emitted when the kill switch is triggered by the oracle below its threshold.

params.oracle: The address of the oracle that met the trigger condition.
params.price: The price that met or exceeded the threshold value.
params.threshold: The threshold value that was compared against the price.

disableOracle(address).details: Disables a specified oracle, preventing it from being used.

params.oracle: The address of the oracle to disable.

hasOracle(address).details: Checks if a given address is an oracle being monitored.

returns._0: True if the address is an oracle being monitored.

numOracles().details: Returns the total number of oracles being monitored.

oracleAt(uint256).details: Returns the address of the oracle at a given index.

params.index: The index of the oracle in the storage array.

returns._0: The address of the oracle at the specified index.

oracles().details: Returns an array containing the addresses of all oracles being monitored.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

reset().details: Reset the module so that the kill switch can only be triggered if one of      the oracles is below the threshold.

setOracle(address,uint256).details: Sets or updates the oracle with a new threshold value.

params.oracle: The address of the oracle to set or update.
params.threshold: The new threshold value to associate with the oracle.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

trigger(address).details: If the kill switch has not been triggered, the oracle threshold has been defined,         and the oracle is below the threshold, the kill switch is triggered. This will         disable borrowing on all assets. If the kill switch has been triggered, this         function will allow disabling borrowing on all assets until the kill switch is reset.

params.oracle: The address of the oracle which is below the threshold. If the kill switch                has been triggered, this parameter is ignored.

oracleThresholds.details: Returns the threshold for the provided oracle.
oracleThresholds.return: The threshold for the provided oracle.

returns._0: The threshold for the provided oracle.

pool.details: Returns the address of the data provider.
pool.return: The address of the data provider.

returns._0: The address of the data provider.

poolConfigurator.details: Returns the address of the pool configurator.
poolConfigurator.return: The address of the pool configurator.

returns._0: The address of the pool configurator.

triggered.details: Returns true if the kill switch has been triggered.
triggered.return: A boolean indicating whether the kill switch has been triggered.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the kill switch has been triggered.

trigger(address).notice: Permissionless function to trigger the kill switch.
